video_title: Melo Says This Is a MUST WIN for the Knicks Against LeBron’s Sixers!

quotes.speaker: The Kid Mero
quotes.summary_phrase: Knicks' early season struggles and championship hangover concerns
quotes.excerpt: Do the Knicks have a championship hangover right now or is there any actual concern?

text_blocks.speaker: The Kid Mero
text_blocks.text: The Knicks are just one and three in the East to start the season. Do the Knicks have a championship hangover right now or is there any actual concern?

text_blocks.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
text_blocks.text: It does not matter. Right now the Knicks are the NBA champions. Every place they go in, everybody they are getting up, they are waking up, they are like, oh, we are going against the Knicks.

quotes.speaker: The Kid Mero
quotes.summary_phrase: Expectations for Mitchell Robinson and his role off the bench
quotes.excerpt: I want 12 and 8 from Mitchell Robinson coming off the bench.

text_blocks.speaker: The Kid Mero
text_blocks.text: What are you expecting from Mitchell Robinson?

text_blocks.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
text_blocks.text: I want 12 and 8 from Mitchell Robinson coming off the bench. That is what you do. You have been a double-double guy your whole life. From elementary school you have been a double-double guy. So coming off the bench in the minutes that you are going to be playing, that you should be playing as a backup center, if you are giving us those numbers off the bench, you are the backup center. You might end up playing alongside Mitchell Robinson.

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: Why the upcoming game against the 76ers is a must-win
quotes.excerpt: If the Knicks go down 2-0 to the 76ers, then that means we have problems with these guys.
quotes.quote: If the Knicks go down 2-0 to the 76ers, then that means we have problems with these guys. That is going to linger all year long. We are a one home and we are a two early. No, no, no. As a player, I have seen this with the team before. I am not looking at the whole season now. I am looking at right now. We have played these guys. This is the team that they say is going to be there with us in the Eastern Conference Finals.

quotes.speaker: The Kid Mero
quotes.summary_phrase: The impact of LeBron James joining the 76ers
quotes.excerpt: They waited for LeBron James to pick a team and then was like, to the 76ers.

text_blocks.speaker: The Kid Mero
text_blocks.text: They waited for LeBron James to pick a team and then was like, to the 76ers.

text_blocks.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
text_blocks.text: Yes. Now you get it. They know. The Knicks are what butter is the bread in the NBA. Everybody knows it. When they are on TV, ratings are sky-high. Like, we know. So in the beginning of the NBA season, I am sure they are talking about, you know, spirit of competition whatever, BS. Everybody watches the Knicks.
